title: AlgebraPhysicsFlows mathematical coverage
scope: An initial, explicitly scoped survey and tested implementation. Not a census of all mathematics and not a proof of universality.
classification_basis: Representation status applies only to each record's explicit scope. Catalog-only rows are initial triage, not established minimality results. Native registrations use Algebra and the existing operations interfaces; the optional Domain/Structure prototype does not execute those registrations. Implementation, empirical testing and mathematical proof are independent axes.

sources.role: discovery taxonomy; not a correctness certificate
discovery taxonomy; not a correctness certificate

extensions.reason: Law statements and finite tests do not establish universally quantified laws, extensional equality or proof obligations.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: Attach typed law/equivalence witnesses with independently checked evidence and explicit assumptions.
extensions.alternative_representation: Store an unreviewed structure specification and finite counterexamples; do not assert certified membership.

extensions.reason: Smoothness, convergence, completeness and integrability cannot be inferred from an arbitrary executable callback or a finite prefix.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: Restricted analytic representations with membership/regularity witnesses, moduli or validated external certificates.
extensions.alternative_representation: Use exact rational polynomials or finite prefixes with their restricted scope named.

extensions.reason: General measures require measurable spaces, countable additivity and almost-everywhere equivalence; finite weights alone lose this meaning.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: A measure-space specification with measurable-map/integrability witnesses and quotient-aware equality.
extensions.alternative_representation: Use a normalized finite distribution on its explicit finite support.

extensions.reason: The carrier or result membership depends on a value such as a base point, dimension, parameter or geometric base object.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: A domain-family resolver and checked dependent pair carrying its index and fiber witness.
extensions.alternative_representation: Use one fixed fiber/dimension with an explicit Domain; do not erase the index.

extensions.reason: Representatives must be identified under an explicit equivalence and operations must descend independently of representative choice.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: Quotient domains parameterized by an equivalence witness and well-defined-operation obligations.
extensions.alternative_representation: Use canonical representatives only where normalization and equality are justified.

extensions.reason: Exact algebraic/spectral objects need certified symbolic representations and algorithms beyond the rational subset shipped here.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: Optional domain-aware CAS adapters with exact value codecs, assumptions and result validation.
extensions.alternative_representation: Use Q, Q(i), rational matrices or an unevaluated symbolic specification; never relabel doubles as exact.

extensions.reason: A candidate solution does not establish existence, uniqueness, completeness of a solution family or numerical convergence.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: Solver adapters returning candidate families plus separate existence/uniqueness/completeness evidence and error bounds.
extensions.alternative_representation: Use polynomial primitives or a finite exhaustive search and state that restricted problem.

extensions.reason: Local data, restriction maps and gluing/descent conditions are essential; a finite set of points or labels loses this structure.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: Indexed structured diagrams with restriction/composition laws and gluing witnesses, built on dependent domains.
extensions.alternative_representation: Store a presentation/diagram with unresolved obligations and delegate specialized algorithms.

extensions.reason: Objects and arrows alone omit identities, composability, equality, universe size and (for higher cases) coherence data.
extensions.smallest_required_extension: Typed source/target diagrams with explicit identities/laws; higher cases additionally need levels and coherence witnesses.
extensions.alternative_representation: Use a finite typed operation graph as an engineering graph, without claiming a category.

Spectral and matrix polynomial operations require square dimension at most 32. Matrix polynomial evaluation and natural powers allow degree/exponent at most 10000. Each calculation shares 5000000 arithmetic work units across matrix products, diagonal shifts, power elimination and eigenspace reductions. Exceeding a cap raises IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE, not a mathematical nonexistence result. Other matrix operations keep their existing scope.

Rational root search and root multiplicity accept degree at most 64. Search uses exact trial division of primitive integer coefficients with at most 100000 trial divisions, 100000 signed candidate pairs, 50000 divisors per coefficient, and 1000000 coefficient visits; it may fail for large coefficients even at degree two. Exhaustion raises IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE and never yields a partial root list. Coefficient bit lengths are unbounded. These caps do not restrict existing polynomial arithmetic.

Spectral and matrix polynomial operations require square dimension at most 32. Matrix polynomial evaluation and natural powers allow degree/exponent at most 10000. Each calculation shares 5000000 arithmetic work units across matrix products, diagonal shifts, power elimination and eigenspace reductions. Exceeding a cap raises IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE, not a mathematical nonexistence result. Other matrix operations keep their existing scope.

Rational root search and root multiplicity accept degree at most 64. Search uses exact trial division of primitive integer coefficients with at most 100000 trial divisions, 100000 signed candidate pairs, 50000 divisors per coefficient, and 1000000 coefficient visits; it may fail for large coefficients even at degree two. Exhaustion raises IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE and never yields a partial root list. Coefficient bit lengths are unbounded. These caps do not restrict existing polynomial arithmetic.
